notes:
## Better
- Updates arrive even when the website is down: E-Sys MAX also checks a second address for new versions.
- Code several changes now goes on to the next module on E-Sys 24 too, where E-Sys shows its result in the dashboard instead of a report window.
- When the licence cannot be checked, the message says why in plain words, and points at the sign-in page on hotel or guest Wi-Fi.
## Safer
- Clearing faults through E-Sys checks the connected car again before each module.
- Problem reports leave out every login, password and PIN line.
- A backup folder E-Sys MAX cannot write to is refused when you choose it.
## Fixed
- Offline wording now says a paid licence works offline for up to 14 days at a time, as the licence terms say.
- One recommended E-Sys version (25.10) everywhere.
